gaps.explanation: No business-type detail lines. Proprietary funds statement (p10 Water/Sewer/Electric columns, p11 Storm Water/Solid Waste/Total Enterprise/Internal Service columns, printed pp26-27). JSON business-type receipts = Total Enterprise Funds total operating revenues 20,626,636 + Investment earnings 967,468 = 21,594,104. Added one line per non-zero enterprise cell (Internal Service Fund excluded; Operating grants row is '-' in every column this year). Row checks: Charges for services 4,166,735 + 7,864,559 + 2,545,291 = 14,576,585; Franchise fees Electric 4,406,469; Fees, taxes, permits and licenses 97,940 + 53,924 + 487,918 + 1,200 = 640,982; Sales tax 33,659 + 577,500 + 24,976 = 636,135; Misc operating revenues 248,483 + 97,392 + 20,590 = 366,465; Investment earnings 397,363 + 396,000 + 53,155 + 29,949 + 91,001 = 967,468. Column totals as printed: Water 4,546,817, Sewer 8,593,375, Electric 4,406,469, Storm Water 512,894, Solid Waste 2,567,081. Sum of added lines 21,594,104 = statement.

gaps.explanation: No business-type detail lines. JSON business-type disbursements = Total Enterprise total operating expenses 11,039,499 + Interest expense, net 874,848 + Gain (loss) on disposal of assets net (969) = 11,915,316 (pp10-11). Added one line per non-zero enterprise cell. Column operating totals as printed: Water 3,138,983, Sewer 5,115,941, Electric 163,667, Storm Water 519,878, Solid Waste 2,101,030 (sum 11,039,499). Interest expense, net: Water (1,021) + Sewer (869,852) + Solid Waste (3,975) = 874,848 (recorded positive like the statement line). Gain (loss) on disposal of asset: Water (1,061) loss and Solid Waste 92 gain are both printed cells; the statement line is their printed net (969). Added as Water 1,061 and Solid Waste -92 in the expenditure section (a loss raises, a gain lowers the expense, as in the statement line), 1,061 - 92 = 969. Row checks: Personnel services 1,016,215 + 1,632,818 + 39,134 + 664,118 = 3,352,285; Depreciation 1,015,012 + 1,943,229 + 163,667 + 428,049 + 242,869 = 3,792,826; Sales tax remitted 66,787 + 474,099 + 29,344 = 570,230. Sum of added lines 11,039,499 + 874,848 + 969 = 11,915,316 = statement.
